title: Senior Systems Engineer
description_text:
•  Must know

     

     

    • Active Directory Architecture, FSMO, Trusts, replication issues, GPO troubleshooting, Sites and services
    • DNS troubleshooting
    • DHCP knowledge
    • Windows Server core troubleshooting (Server performance analysis, BSOD,)
    • Server Hardware (HP, Dell, IBM, Cisco UCS, Blade Servers) / Raid troubleshooting.
    • Backup troubleshooting
    • Windows cluster troubleshooting & Migration and log analysis.
    • Windows patching troubleshooting
    • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for Major Incidents and P1/P2 cases
    • Migration - DHCP\AD\File and print server.
    • Certificate authority (Root CA / Subordinate CA), IIS website renewals.
    • Azure resources management
    • Azure AD connect
    • ITIL Process
    • 24*7 rotation shifts



    Good to have

    • VMware
    • Azure Certification ( AZ-104)
    • Windows in place Upgradation
    • Storage Basic
    • Network Basic
    • Basic PowerShell Scripting
    • Windows vulnerability
    • Defender
    • .

    Job Details:

    Roles and Responsibilities

     

    • Providing support to US & Europe customers hence communication should be crisp.
    • Interact with customers, end-users and team members.
    • Escalation point for lower tier technical teams
    • Installation, configuration, maintenance and support for hardware, operating systems and applications
    • Participation in completing customer change requests and problem ticket resolution outside of normal business hours.

     

     


TRAVEL:

up to 15%
